> Marcus / Laura: this looks like an unapplied cash issue caused by entity mapping at time of deposit.

I can move the receipt and create a contra entry to reclass the cash to 1100-02, but we'll need an approval and a short paper trail for audit (email thread + remittance).

- Revenue recognition: looks like revenue was not yet recognized for INV-4489 (billing period May). Laura — if we reclass cash only, revenue recognition entries stay the same; if we reverse any revenue JE we should coordinate.

Proposed next step: I'll draft the reallocation journal and circulate for approval. Ben, can you sanity-check the GLs?

Marcus — thanks for the notes. I reviewed the billing file: INV-4489 was included in the May bill run but revenue recognition posting is scheduled for 2028-05-31 (month-end). So moving the cash will not retroactively change recognized revenue today. However, because VAT credit was posted under Holdings tax code, we need to reverse VAT-CR-4489 and rebook it to Solutions before the period close to avoid a mismatched VAT payable at month end.

Kimberly (Tax) — can you confirm the reversal journal format? My preferred route is:
1) Marcus posts reallocation receipt journal: DR 1100-02, CR 1100-01 (reclass)
2) Tax posts VAT reversal: DR VAT-CR-4489 (reverse), CR VAT-RECEIVABLE-HOLDINGS, then new VAT credit under Solutions tax ledger.
3) Finance posts a short memo and attaches remittance + bank trace for audit.

If Tax confirms, we should be able to close without revenue restatements.
